soft_issues: The extract is word-broken across about 14 800 lines. Formula pages were walked for methods and results, not re-derived equation by equation.

claim_checks.claim: Stage-structured Bayesian hierarchical lice model at individual farms. Ecological Modelling 359 (2017) 333-348. Open access CC BY 4.0.
claim_checks.extract_quote: we present a fully mechanistic stage-structured population model for the salmon louse, also allowing for complexities involved in the hierarchical structure of full scale salmon farming.
claim_checks.note: Journal, volume, pages, and CC BY 4.0 are on the title page.

claim_checks.claim: Cage-level data on 32 marine farms. Twelve sit just north of Frøya. Stocked 2011-2013, slaughtered 2012-2014. Last 3-11 months for five farms held out.
claim_checks.extract_quote: The main body of data in the present study consist of cage-level data from 32 marine salmon farms in Norway, of which 12 farms are aggregated just north of the island Frøya in Mid-Norway
claim_checks.note: Stocking and slaughter years are in the same data paragraph.

claim_checks.claim: External recruitment uses g(d) = exp(-0.618 d^0.568) from Aldrin et al. 2013, not re-estimated. That earlier kernel used more than eight years of data on about 1400 farms.
claim_checks.extract_quote: This distance function is taken from Aldrin et al. (2013), and is based on a data-driven model for lice abundance estimated from more than eight years of data on all 1400 Norwegian salmon farms

claim_checks.claim: Neighbouring adult females are assumed to be at stage-age 10. The authors call that choice rather arbitrary and say results were insensitive to it.
claim_checks.extract_quote: The assumed stage-age of 10 is rather arbitrary, but the results are insensitive to this choice.

claim_checks.claim: Internal recruitment averaged 25 percent (interval 23-26 percent), median 19 percent, farm range about 4 to 73 percent. Sixteen of 32 farms had a neighbour within 3.54 km seaway.
claim_checks.extract_quote: On average over all farms, this proportion is 25% (C.I. 23–26%), with a median of 19.
claim_checks.note: Farm range 4 to 73 percent and the 3.54 km split of 16 plus 16 farms are in the same results block.

claim_checks.claim: Expected values fitted chalimus, adult female, and other mobile stages reasonably well. Held-out months were consistent with observations.
claim_checks.extract_quote: The model generated expected values that fitted the observed infection levels of the chalimus, adult female and other mobile stages of salmon lice, reasonably well.
claim_checks.note: Held-out consistency is in the abstract.

claim_checks.claim: At 10 degrees C, ten days after bath treatment, expected cumulative mortality was 0.99 for hydrogen peroxide, 0.94 for deltamethrin or cypermethrin, and 0.75 for azamethiphos. No Allee effect: reproduction-rate parameter 493 (interval 482-498). Cleaner-fish daily mortality 0.028. At 10 percent ratio, daily lice mortality 0.079 and adult-lice life expectancy 8.2 to 5.2 days.
claim_checks.extract_quote: the estimated expected cumulative mortality of lice (found by simulation) in the PA or A stages due to bath treatments (i.e. non-feed) ten days post treatment at 10 ◦C, were high for hydrogen peroxide (0.99, C.I. 0.97–1.00)
claim_checks.note: Azamethiphos, Allee-effect, and cleaner-fish paragraphs are in the same results and discussion block.

claim_checks.claim: Host-density dependence in the introduction is cited from earlier work. This paper does not analyse coastal plans or municipal siting.
claim_checks.extract_quote: Large-scale host density dependence acting on pathogen transmission has been demonstrated in salmon farming production systems
claim_checks.note: Citations are Aldrin, Jansen, Kristoffersen and related papers. No planning analysis in the extract.

evidence_direction_note: not_applicable is correct. The paper estimates a farm lice population model. It does not claim a causal policy or siting effect.
priority_questions_note: A5 only. Neighbourhood seaway distance and internal versus external recruitment speak to density and biosecurity. Not A1, A2, A3 or A6. Adjacent, not a siting paper.
coi_note: No competing-interests statement. Funding is FHF 900970. Marine Harvest, Salmar and Måsøval supplied data. coi_declared remains unclear.
extract_coverage: Walked the full extracted.md: title page and abstract, introduction and density citations, data (32 farms, Frøya, 2011-2014), stage-structured methods including the imported kernel and stage-age 10, results on fit, internal recruitment, treatments and Allee effect, discussion, acknowledgements and funding. Formula pages were read for methods and results, not re-derived.
